headline: China Hosts Nearly Half of Global Clean Industrial Facilities
summary: China accounts for 49% of the world's clean industrial plants following massive investments in energy transition projects, reaching $45 billion this year.
why: China is the world's second-largest economy and a dominant player in global manufacturing, green technology, and renewable energy supply chains.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: China's clean industrial plant share reflects national investment trends in renewable energy infrastructure.
